original_lock_is_sm_nft.meaning: the original lock being split is marked as an SM-NFT

split_bonus_applied.meaning: the split function applies calculate_sm_nft_bonus to the resulting lock

unearned_bonus_tokens_farmed.meaning: the attacker obtains additional bonus tokens that should only have been granted once

assumptions: The split function is invoked on an SM-NFT lock.
calculate_sm_nft_bonus is the bonus routine named by the report.

unresolved.description: The intent forbids applying calculate_sm_nft_bonus during split, but the impact only states that unearned bonus tokens are farmed; the report does not give a direct observable that the bonus was applied during a specific split as the V witness, so the V is a grounded Boolean for the farming outcome rather than a direct falsifier of the no-bonus-on-split relation.

limitations: The impact is encoded as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric amount or per-split bonus value.
The relation between the no-bonus-on-split intent and the farming impact is supported only indirectly by the relation_context excerpts.
